description.zh: ? 一句话：按文档讲的是什么来找，不用记得原词。用你选的模型（“本地模型”插件或 Ollama，都在本机、不上传；或云服务的密钥）
description.en: ? a sentence: finds documents by what they are about, not by their words. Uses the model you pick (the Local models plugin or Ollama, on this PC with nothing uploaded; or a cloud service's key)

notes.zh: 模型服务新增“本地模型（离线）”：装了“本地模型”插件并下载嵌入模型后，建索引和查找都在这台电脑上算，文档的文字不上传；还没装或没下载时，提示行回车打开“本地模型”的卡片。发往本机的请求不走系统代理。权限不变。
notes.en: New service Local model (offline): with the Local models plugin and its embedding model, indexing and searching are computed on this PC and no document text is uploaded; when it is missing, Enter on the hint row opens the Local models card. Requests to this computer never go through the system proxy. Permissions unchanged.
